analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 RSI 중립 구간 유지, ADX 16.7로 추세 약화. MACD 히스토그램 또한 악화되며 약세 신호 강화. 5일 고가가 20일 고가 대비 낮아 Lower High 패턴 형성. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 위축되어 방향성 부재 확인.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI has remained in the neutral zone for 3 consecutive sessions, with ADX weakening to 16.7. The MACD histogram is also worsening, reinforcing bearish signals. A Lower High pattern is forming as the 5-day high is below the 20-day high. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.82 times the 5-day average, confirming a lack of directional conviction.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 1,693,000) vs SMA5 (KRW 1,687,452) / SMA20 (KRW 1,605,656) / SMA50 (KRW 1,907,688): short-term above, mid-term below, long-term below
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 1,822,762) / SMA200 (KRW 1,290,266): weakening mid-to-long term trend
· 52-week position (49.0%) + current price level at historical midpoint
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (49.2→49.9) + neutral assessment + continued sideways movement
· MACD histogram trajectory (43724.2525→30779.0734) + worsening assessment + bearish reversal signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band KRW 1,605,656) + band width at 25.72%, indicating moderate volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.82) + decreased confidence in price movement
· Current phase assessment (Accumulation) + entry conditions unmet, maintaining a wait-and-see stance
